1	# webERP database, install, transaction posting and reporting
2	
3	This is the webERP application: the code that installs and upgrades its MySQL/MariaDB database, the pages that run sales, purchasing, stock, manufacturing and ledger postings, and the reports and documents built from the results. It hands work to MySQL, `mysqldump`/`gzip`, Dompdf, SMTP, FTP, Nominatim, Google Translate and currency feeds, and takes version state and settings from `config` and the session.
4	
5	## The areas
6	
7	- **Database upgrade and migration scripts.** Carries a database forward from 2.7 to the current release on two separate tracks. The legacy `.sql` track is driven by `VersionNumber`, but it is reached only when the `VersionNumber` row is missing or `scripts.pagesecurity` cannot be read (`source/webERP/includes/GetConfig.php:30-43`). The numbered PHP updates in `sql/updates/` are driven by `DBUpdateNumber`. It also holds the backup page, the one-off per-version pages, the user-defined sales-report SQL builder and the form-field helpers. It takes version state from `config` and the session. It leaves tables and config keys that every other area reads. The installer includes its `UpgradeDB_<DBType>` helpers. The reporting area runs the report builder.
8	
9	- **Installer, seed data, schema, API, QA, MRP, petty cash, admin pages, tests and build tooling.** Builds a fresh database through the six-step wizard, seeds charts of accounts, menus and security, and provides the login/session bootstrap. It also holds the XML-RPC API, MRP, QA samples, the petty-cash cycle, CSV imports, settings pages, and the CI and release scripts. It hands the other areas their tables and sessions. Its API and petty-cash pages post into the same ledgers as the posting area. The `gltotals` triggers it installs are MySQL-only, and a trigger failure counts only as a warning (`source/webERP/includes/InstallFunctions.php:737-753`).
10	
11	## Flows across areas
12	
13	1. The session bootstrap (installer area) compares only `DBVersion` with `DBUpdateNumber` and redirects to the upgrade area. It does not compare `VersionNumber`, although the comment at line 272 says it does (`source/webERP/includes/session.php:272-293`). `GetConfig` sends users to `UpgradeDatabase.php` only when the `VersionNumber` row is missing or `scripts.pagesecurity` cannot be read, and the second of those redirects has no `exit()` (`source/webERP/includes/GetConfig.php:30-43`). A database on an old legacy version that still has a `VersionNumber` row is therefore never sent to the legacy `.sql` scripts. It goes straight to numbered updates 0..N, which assume the 4.15.x schema.
14	
15	## Conventions
16	
17	  - Among the numbered updates, 0–16, 25–35 and 43 call `UpdateDBNo` only when `$_SESSION['Updates']['Errors']` is 0. Updates 17–24 and 36–42 call it unconditionally (`source/webERP/includes/UpgradeDB_mariadb.php:751-757`, `source/webERP/sql/updates/42.php:1-11`). The newest file, 43, is guarded but 42 is not, so the next update copied from either one decides whether failures stop the version number.
18	
19	  - In the XML-RPC API, `WorkOrderIssue` is the pattern to copy. It fetches its transaction number once (`source/webERP/api/includes/api_workorders.php:294`). `StockAdjustment` and `WorkOrderReceive` read the item row at the wrong index, so GL posts come out zero or blank. `StockAdjustment` also calls `GetNextTransNo(17)` four times, so the stockmove, the two GL rows and the final `systypes` update each get a different transaction number. Its GL lines cannot be tied to each other or to the stockmove by type and number, and inquiries and balance checks see each line as an unbalanced one-line transaction. The increments also run before `DB_Txn_Begin`, so their `FOR UPDATE` locks are not held (`source/webERP/api/includes/api_stock.php:787-848`, `source/webERP/includes/SQL_CommonFunctions.php:16-26`).
20	
21	  - `EnsureGLEntriesBalance` is called only by the API invoice and credit-note functions. No web posting page calls it (`source/webERP/includes/SQL_CommonFunctions.php:346-373`, `source/webERP/api/includes/api_salesorders.php:1377-1443`).
22	
23	## Hazards
24	
25	- The two version markers do not verify each other. `$_SESSION['Updates']['Errors']` accumulates across the whole upgrade run and is not reset between updates. After one guarded update fails, every later guarded update still runs its SQL but skips `UpdateDBNo`, while the unguarded updates (17–24 and 36–42) advance `DBUpdateNumber` anyway, so the failed update is never retried. Updates that skipped `UpdateDBNo` have already applied their DDL and rerun on the next attempt (`source/webERP/Z_UpgradeDatabase.php:50-57`, `source/webERP/Z_UpgradeDatabase.php:121-139`).
26	
27	- Update 17 sets `$_SESSION['Updates']['Errors']` and `Successes` back to 0 partway through the run (`source/webERP/sql/updates/17.php:21-22`). This erases failures from earlier updates, so updates 25–35 pass their guard and record themselves as done. An upgrade from below 17 can show 0 errors on the result page and hide the earlier error messages, which are printed only when `Errors>0` (`source/webERP/Z_UpgradeDatabase.php:145-158`).
28	
29	- Update 17 rebuilds `gltotals` and calls `UpdateDBNo` with no guard. Update 20 then drops `chartdetails` and the `gltrans.posted` column whether or not that rebuild succeeded. If it failed, the old balance table is gone and the version number has moved on, leaving no GL totals source to recover from. Update 20 also checks `DB_error_no($Result)` against a variable its own helper calls never set (`source/webERP/sql/updates/17.php:10-90`, `source/webERP/sql/updates/20.php:1-19`).
30	
31	- Triggers keep `gltotals` in step with `gltrans`. Rows that predate them are not repaired by any area. `CreatePeriod` builds the SQL that seeds `gltotals` for a new period but never runs it, so a period's rows exist only after a `gltrans` insert fires the insert trigger (`source/webERP/includes/DateFunctions.php:1211-1225`). The update and delete triggers use a plain UPDATE and rely on that row already existing (`source/webERP/install/sql/triggers/gltrans_after_delete.sql:1-6`). Code that reads `gltotals` with an INNER JOIN, or expects one row per account and period as update 17 seeds, misses accounts in new periods.
32	
33	- The `gltotals` triggers are MySQL-only. The installer notes they will not work on Postgres and treats their failure as a warning (`source/webERP/includes/InstallFunctions.php:737-753`). All GL statements (`GLTrialBalance`, `GLBalanceSheet`, `GLProfit_Loss`) read `gltotals` (`source/webERP/GLTrialBalance.php:91-145`). A Postgres install, for which `ConnectDB_postgres` and `UpgradeDB_postgres` exist, therefore posts to `gltrans` but shows empty financial statements with no error. Whether Postgres is still a supported install target is unconfirmed.
34	
35	- Commits precede side effects such as email and file deletes. In the API, `EnsureGLEntriesBalance` runs before the commit, but when it rolls back the API code carries on. It updates `salesorders`, writes `debtortrans` and the tax rows outside a transaction, calls `DB_Txn_Commit`, and returns success with the invoice number. An unbalanced API invoice therefore leaves a customer invoice with no GL entries, and on the lines read the rollback error does not reach `$Errors` (`source/webERP/api/includes/api_salesorders.php:1377-1443`). When `EnsureGLEntriesBalance` corrects a rounding difference, it adjusts an arbitrary GL row. It takes the first row of `SELECT counterindex, MAX(amount) ... GROUP BY counterindex`, not the largest line, so corrections can land on a tax or freight line. Any copy of the function inherits this (`source/webERP/includes/SQL_CommonFunctions.php:359-369`). Recurring auto-invoices commit the order before the invoice transaction and never check balance. A failed invoice is never retried.
36

41	- [webERP sales, purchasing, stock, work-order, GL and master-data pages](weberp-sales-purchasing-stock-work-order-gl-and-master-data--151/brief.md) — This area is the set of webERP PHP pages that run order-to-cash, procure-to-pay, stock movement, manufacturing and general-ledger maintenance, plus supporting…
42	- [webERP accounts-receivable, accounts-payable, bank and GL posting area](weberp-accounts-receivable-accounts-payable-bank-and-gl-post-152/brief.md) — This area covers webERP pages and libraries that post receipts, payments, credit notes, allocations, bank matching, depreciation and commission to gltrans…
43	- [webERP reporting and document output](weberp-reporting-and-document-output-153/brief.md) — This area is webERP's reporting layer: a report-writer engine with its admin builder, plus many standalone report, inquiry and PDF pages.

2	
3	When implementing webERP and importing data from another system, ad hoc
4	item "notes" are often available and worth keeping. webERP has no item
5	notes feature; today people put such text in the item's long description.
6	
7	Add the option to store zero to many notes about a stock item: a way to
8	add, view, edit and delete an item's notes, reachable from the item's page,
9	and a way to bring notes in when items are imported.

# Task: notes on stock items

When implementing webERP and importing data from another system, ad hoc
item "notes" are often available and worth keeping. webERP has no item
notes feature; today people put such text in the item's long description.

Add the option to store zero to many notes about a stock item: a way to
add, view, edit and delete an item's notes, reachable from the item's page,
and a way to bring notes in when items are imported.

1	# webERP stock item maintenance: Stocks.php plus the Z_ChangeStockCategory.php and Z_ChangeStockCode.php utilities
2	
3	Part of [webERP sales, purchasing, stock, work-order, GL and master-data pages](weberp-sales-purchasing-stock-work-order-gl-and-master-data--151/brief.md) (path from the export's root): its brief says how work moves through the area and what repairs a failed step.
4	
5	Stocks.php is the item create, update and delete page, with navigation, multilingual descriptions, category properties and image upload. The two Z_ utilities rename a stock category code or an item code across the related tables. All of it reads and writes `stockmaster` and the tables around it directly, and it takes transaction numbers from `GetNextTransNo`.
6	
7	## Contract
8	- **In:**
9	  - POST/GET form fields: `StockID` (trimmed, uppercased), `NextItem`, `PreviousItem`, `UpdateCategories`, `New`, `submit`, `delete`, `ClearImage`, `ItemPicture` (file).
10	  - Item fields: `Description`, `LongDescription`, `Units`, `BarCode`, `Volume`, `GrossWeight`, `NetWeight`, `EOQ`, `Controlled`, `Serialised`, `Perishable`, `NextSerialNo`, `MBFlag`, `CategoryID`, `Pansize`, `ShrinkFactor`, `Discontinued`, `DiscountCategory`, `TaxCat`, `DecimalPlaces`.
11	  - Language fields: `Description_<LanguageId>`, `LongDescription_<LanguageId>`.
12	  - Property fields: `PropertyCounter`, `PropID<i>`, `PropNumeric<i>`, `PropType<i>`, `PropValue<i>`, `PropMin<i>`, `PropMax<i>`.
13	  - Z_ChangeStockCategory.php: `ProcessStockChange`, `OldStockCategory`, `NewStockCategory`.
14	  - Z_ChangeStockCode.php: `OldStockID`, `NewStockID` (uppercased).
15	  - Session values: `ItemDescriptionLanguages` (comma-separated), `MaxImageSize` (KB), `part_pics_dir`, `CompanyRecord['gllink_stock']`, `DefaultDateFormat`, `DefaultTaxCategory`, `SelectedStockItem`.
16	- **Out, written tables:**
17	  - `stockmaster`
18	  - `stockdescriptiontranslations`
19	  - `stockitemproperties`
20	  - `locstock`
21	  - `gltrans` (type 0 journals)
22	  - `stockcategory`
23	  - `stockcatproperties`
24	  - `salesanalysis`
25	  - `internalstockcatrole`
26	  - about 35 item-keyed tables for the item-code rename (listed under Z_ChangeStockCode.php below)
27	- **Out, files:** item images at `part_pics_dir/<StockID>.<png|jpg|jpeg>`.
28	- **Out, delete:** rows deleted from `locstock`, `prices`, `purchdata`, `bom` (parent), `stockitemproperties`, `stockdescriptiontranslations` and `stockmaster`.
29	
30	## Entry points
31	
32	### Stocks.php, request start
33	No permission check and no FormID check are shown.
34	1. `if GET/POST StockID set -> trim, uppercase to $StockID`, else `$StockID = ''`.
35	2. `if NextItem -> SELECT stockmaster WHERE stockid > $StockID ORDER ASC LIMIT 1`. A hit sets `$StockID` to it; no hit sets `$HasNext = false`. The `Description_*` POST values are unset.
36	3. `if PreviousItem -> stockid < $StockID ORDER DESC LIMIT 1`. A hit sets `$StockID` to it; no hit sets `$HasPrev = false`. The `Description_*` POST values are unset.
37	4. `if $StockID != '' and UpdateCategories not set -> count stockmaster WHERE stockid=$StockID`. A count of 0 sets `$New = 1`, otherwise `$New = 0`.
38	5. `if POST New set -> $New = $_POST['New']`.
39	
40	### Stocks.php, image upload
41	Runs when `ItemPicture` name is not empty.
42	- `$ImgExt` comes from the file name. `$FileName = part_pics_dir/StockID.ImgExt`. `$UploadTheFile = 'Yes'` to start.
43	- `$UploadTheFile = 'No'` (with a warning) for each of these:
44	  - `ImgExt not in (png, jpg, jpeg)`
45	  - `size > MaxImageSize*1024`
46	  - `type == 'text/plain'`
47	  - `error == 6`
48	  - `not is_writable(part_pics_dir)`
49	- Existing `StockID.png`, `StockID.jpg` and `StockID.jpeg` files are unlinked first. If an unlink fails, an error is shown and `$UploadTheFile = 'No'`.
50	- `if $UploadTheFile == 'Yes' -> move_uploaded_file`. The result message is a link on success, or 'Something is wrong with uploading' on failure.
51	
52	### Stocks.php, submit validation
53	Each failure sets `$InputError = 1`, shows an error and records the field in `$Errors`. All checks run (no early exit).
54	1. `!isset(Description) or len > 50 or len == 0` -> Description.
55	2. `len(LongDescription) == 0` -> LongDescription.
56	3. `len(StockID) == 0` -> StockID.
57	4. `ContainsIllegalCharacters(StockID) or strpos(StockID,' ')` -> StockID, and `$StockID = ''`.
58	5. `len(Units) > 20` -> Units.
59	6. `len(BarCode) > 20` -> BarCode.
60	7. Volume, GrossWeight, NetWeight and EOQ: `!is_numeric(filter_number_format(x))` or `< 0` -> that field.
61	8. `Controlled == 0 and Serialised == 1` -> Serialised.
62	9. `NextSerialNo != 0 and Serialised == 0` -> NextSerialNo.
63	10. `NextSerialNo != 0 and MBFlag != 'M'` -> NextSerialNo.
64	11. `MBFlag in (A, K, D, G) and Controlled == 1` -> Controlled.
65	12. `trim(CategoryID) == ''` -> CategoryID.
66	13. Pansize and ShrinkFactor: `!is_numeric(filter_number_format(x))` -> that field.
67	- `if Serialised == 1 -> DecimalPlaces = 0`.
68	
69	### Stocks.php, extra checks when `$New == 0`
70	The check on `$New` is partly off-screen. The checks below are shown. Each sets `InputError=1`.
71	- `OldMBFlag != MBFlag and OldMBFlag in [M,B] and MBFlag in [A,K,D,G]` combined with:
72	  - `StockQtyRow[0] != 0 and OldMBFlag != G` -> refused, stock on hand.
73	  - `Controlled == 1` -> refused, lot controlled.
74	- `MBFlag == K` and open sales order lines (`stkcode=StockID AND completed=0` and `quantity-qtyinvoiced != 0`) -> refused.
75	- `MBFlag in [K,A,D]` and open purchase order lines -> refused. The lines are those with `purchorderdetails.completed=0`, `purchorders.status not in [Cancelled, Completed, Rejected]` and `quantityord-quantityrecd != 0`.
76	- `OldMBFlag in [M,K,A,G] and MBFlag in [B,D]` and a BOM with `parent=StockID` -> refused.
77	- `OldMBFlag in [M,B,D,G] and MBFlag in [A,K]` and a BOM with `component=StockID` -> refused.
78	- `OldControlled != Controlled and StockQtyRow[0] != 0` -> refused.
79	- `OldSerialised != Serialised and StockQtyRow[0] != 0` -> refused.
80	- Property loop `i < PropertyCounter`: `PropNumeric[i]==1 and (value < PropMin[i] or value > PropMax[i])` -> refused.
81	
82	### Stocks.php, update (`$InputError == 0`, existing item)
83	1. `DB_Txn_Begin`.
84	2. UPDATE `stockmaster` (numeric fields go through `filter_number_format`).
85	3. `if count(languages) > 0` -> per language, DELETE then INSERT in `stockdescriptiontranslations`.
86	4. `if OldDescription != Description or OldLongDescription != LongDescription -> UPDATE stockdescriptiontranslations SET needsrevision='0' WHERE stockid`. This applies to all of the item's translations.
87	5. DELETE `stockitemproperties`, then INSERT per property. `PropType==2` becomes 1 if the value is 'on', otherwise 0. `PropNumeric==1` goes through `filter_number_format`.
88	6. `if OldStockAccount != NewStockAct and gllink_stock == 1` -> `GetNextTransNo(0)` for the journal number. Two `gltrans` type 0 rows follow: debit `NewStockAct` and credit `OldStockAccount`, amount `UnitCost * StockQtyRow[0]`.
89	7. `if OldWIPAccount != NewWIPAct and gllink_stock == 1` -> sum open work order WIP (`workorders.closed=0`), per row `costissued - costrecd`. `if WIPValue != 0` -> `GetNextTransNo(0)`, then two type 0 rows: debit `NewWIPAct`, credit `OldWIPAccount`.
90	8. `DB_Txn_Commit`, then success message.
91	
92	### Stocks.php, insert (new item)
93	- `if DB_num_rows(SELECT stockid WHERE stockid=...) == 1 -> InputError=1, Errors[]='StockID'`, with a duplicate-code message.
94	- Otherwise: `DB_Txn_Begin`, INSERT `stockmaster`.
95	- `if DB_error_no()==0`:
96	  - INSERT `stockdescriptiontranslations` per language, only if there are languages.
97	  - INSERT `stockitemproperties` per property.
98	  - `INSERT INTO locstock SELECT locations.loccode, StockID FROM locations`.
99	  - `DB_Txn_Commit`.
100	  - `if DB_error_no()==0` -> unset the POST fields and set `$New=1`.
101	
102	### Stocks.php, delete
103	Runs when `POST delete` is set and `mb_strlen > 1`. `$CancelDelete = 1` with a warning (and a count) if any of these holds:
104	- `stockmoves` count > 0 for the item.
105	- `bom` with `component=StockID` > 0.
106	- `salesorderdetails` with `stkcode` > 0.
107	- `salesanalysis` > 0.
108	- `purchorderdetails` with `itemcode` > 0.
109	- `GetQuantityOnHand(StockID,'ALL') != 0`.
110	- `offers` count != 0.
111	- `tenderitems` count != 0.
112	
113	If `$CancelDelete == 0`:
114	1. `DB_Txn_Begin`.
115	2. DELETE from `locstock`, `prices`, `purchdata`, `bom` (parent), `stockitemproperties`, `stockdescriptiontranslations` and `stockmaster`, in that order.
116	3. `DB_Txn_Commit`, then success message.
117	4. Unset the POST fields, `$_SESSION['SelectedStockItem']` and `$StockID`; `$New = 1`.
118	
119	### Stocks.php, form display
120	- `if StockID unset/'' or UpdateCategories set` -> blank or new form.
121	- `elseif UpdateCategories unset and InputError != 1` -> load `stockmaster` and `stockdescriptiontranslations` into the form.
122	- `else` -> keep the posted values.
123	- Defaults:
124	  - EOQ, Volume, GrossWeight, NetWeight, Controlled, Pansize, ShrinkFactor, NextSerialNo, DecimalPlaces, Discontinued -> 0.
125	  - `Serialised` -> 0 if empty or `Controlled == 0`.
126	  - `Units` -> 'each'.
127	  - `TaxCat` -> `$_SESSION['DefaultTaxCategory']`.
128	- `MBFlag` select:
129	  - Pre-selected only on A (Assembly), D (Service/Labour) and when unset.
130	  - Kit, Manufactured, Phantom and Purchased are each selected when unset or equal to their own flag. Phantom and Purchased also select on ''.
131	- `NextSerialNo` is shown only if `Serialised == 1 and MBFlag == 'M'`, otherwise a hidden 0.
132	- `if ClearImage` -> unlink the png, jpg and jpeg files. `if is_file` still true -> error 'You do not have access to delete this item image file'.
133	- `if New == 1` -> editable StockID and a `submit` 'Insert New Item' button.
134	- `if New != 1` -> 'Update' and 'Delete This Item' buttons. Delete has a JS confirm.
135	- Previous/Next buttons show if `StockID != '' and InputError == 0`.
136	- Property inputs come from `stockcatproperties WHERE categoryid=CategoryID AND reqatsalesorder=0`. `controltype` 0 is a textbox (numeric gets min/max hidden inputs), 1 is a select (defaultvalue split by comma), 2 is a checkbox. Values come from `stockitemproperties` when `StockID` is set.
137	
138	### Z_ChangeStockCategory.php (`if isset(ProcessStockChange)`)
139	Each check below ends the run with an error:
140	- `old category not in stockcategory` (0 rows).
141	- `ContainsIllegalCharacters(NewStockCategory)`.
142	- `NewStockCategory == ''`.
143	- `new category already exists` (rows != 0).
144	
145	Then:
146	1. `DB_Txn_Begin`.
147	2. INSERT a copy of the old `stockcategory` row under the new id.
148	3. UPDATE `stockcatproperties.categoryid`.
149	4. UPDATE `stockmaster.categoryid`.
150	5. UPDATE `salesanalysis.stkcategory`.
151	6. UPDATE `internalstockcatrole.categoryid`.
152	7. `SET FOREIGN_KEY_CHECKS=1`.
153	8. `DB_Txn_Commit`.
154	9. DELETE the old `stockcategory` row, outside the transaction.
155	
156	### Z_ChangeStockCode.php
157	Each check sets `$InputError = 1`:
158	- `old code not in stockmaster`.
159	- `ContainsIllegalCharacters(NewStockID)`.
160	- `NewStockID == ''`.
161	- `new code already exists`.
162	
163	If `InputError == 0`:
164	1. `DB_IgnoreForeignKeys`, `DB_Txn_Begin`.
165	2. INSERT a new `stockmaster` row.
166	3. `ChangeFieldInTable` over `locstock`, `stockmoves`, `loctransfers`, `mrpdemands`, `mrpplannedorders` (if it exists), `mrprequirements` (if it exists), `mrpsupplies` (if it exists), `salesanalysis`, `orderdeliverydifferenceslog`, `prices`, `salesorderdetails`, `purchorderdetails`, `purchdata`, `shipmentcharges`, `stockcheckfreeze`, `stockcounts`, `grns`, `contractbom`, `bom` (component and parent), `stockrequestitems`, `stockdescriptiontranslations`, `custitem`, `pricematrix`, `pickreqdetails`, `stockitemproperties`, `worequirements` (stockid and parentstockid), `woitems`, `salescatprod`, `stockserialitems`, `stockserialmoves`, `offers`, `tenderitems`, `prodspecs`, `qasamples`. The condensation says 24 calls but lists more tables.
167	4. For each of png, jpg and jpeg: rename the image file, or report 'failed' or 'no image to rename'.
168	5. `DB_ReinstateForeignKeys`, `DB_Txn_Commit`.
169	6. DELETE the old `stockmaster` row.
170	7. If `$_SESSION['SelectedStockItem'] == OldStockID`, set it to `NewStockID`.
171	
172	## Decisions
173	- `Stocks.php` GL journal on account change: the stock account journal is only posted when `gllink_stock == 1`. The WIP journal is also skipped when the net WIP value is 0.
174	- `Stocks.php` MBFlag change (rules above): `stock on hand` blocks M/B to A/K/D/G unless the old flag was G.
175	- `Stocks.php` delete: a `stockmaster` row is only removed when there are no movements, BOM component uses, sales order lines, sales analysis rows, purchase order lines, stock on hand, offers or tenders for the item.
176	- Because the delete guard has no check on `prices`, `purchdata` or `locstock`, those rows are deleted along with the item.
177	- Both Z_ scripts refuse when the new code already exists.
178	
179	## Order and failure
180	- **Update:** everything is inside one transaction. Errors from `DB_query` are re-raised to the caller. No explicit rollback is shown, and `DB_Txn_Commit` follows the later steps.
181	- **Insert:** the transaction wraps all inserts. If the `stockmaster` INSERT fails (`DB_error_no != 0`), the remaining inserts are skipped. No explicit rollback is shown.
182	- **Delete:** the queries are inside a transaction. No check of per-query success before commit is shown.
183	- **Z_ChangeStockCategory:** the old-category DELETE is outside the transaction, after commit. If it fails, both category rows exist. The message for each step is passed to `DB_query` (with the transaction flag `true`).
184	- **Z_ChangeStockCode:** the old `stockmaster` row is deleted after commit. A failed `ChangeFieldInTable` or image rename is not handled; the rename is only reported in the output.
185	- **GetNextTransNo:** it runs `SELECT ... FOR UPDATE`, `UPDATE systypes SET typeno = typeno + 1`, then re-SELECTs `typeno` and returns it. Failures show a 'CRITICAL ERROR' message through `DB_query`. The row lock is held until the surrounding transaction ends, so the number is serialised only inside a transaction. In Stocks.php it is called inside the update transaction, after `DB_Txn_Begin`.
186	- No loops poll or retry.
187	
188	## Connections
189	- **`GetNextTransNo(0)`** (`webERP/includes/SQL_CommonFunctions.php`): called by Stocks.php for the stock and WIP cost journals. Type 0 is the journal type. It reads and increments `systypes.typeno` for `typeid=0` and returns the new value, which Stocks.php uses as `typeno` in `gltrans`.
190	- **`GetQuantityOnHand($StockID,'ALL')`** (behaviour not in this topic): used by the delete guard.
191	- **Helper functions** (behaviour not in this topic): `ContainsIllegalCharacters`, `filter_number_format`, `locale_number_format`, `GetImageLink`, `ChangeFieldInTable`, `DB_IgnoreForeignKeys`, `DB_ReinstateForeignKeys`.
192	- **Shared tables:** `stockmaster`, `stockcategory`, `stockcatproperties`, `locstock`, `locations`, `gltrans`, `systypes`, `workorders`, `woitems`, `salesorderdetails`, `purchorderdetails`, `purchorders`, `bom` and the other tables named above.
193	- **Session:** `$_SESSION['SelectedStockItem']` is shared with the other stock pages. It is unset on delete and updated on code rename.
194	
195	## Conclusions
196	- Stocks.php posts the stock journal using `UnitCost * StockQtyRow[0]`. This only happens if the stock account changed with `gllink_stock == 1`. `gltrans` rows are not checked against the GL accounts and no balance check is made, but the two rows carry the same amount in opposite directions.
197	- Changing a category's stock accounts does not itself post journals here. Only item-level account changes do. The category-change path appears to set the accounts through `UpdateCategories` and the form. The same item-level journals are posted from `$OldStockAccount != $NewStockAct`.
198	- Z_ChangeStockCategory moves only `stockcatproperties`, `stockmaster`, `salesanalysis` and `internalstockcatrole`. It leaves other tables that refer to the category alone. Other parts keeping their own copy of the category code will keep the old one.
199	- Z_ChangeStockCode has no duplicate guard beyond the form check. Submitting the same rename twice fails the second time, since the old code no longer exists.
200	- Image-name checks in Stocks.php do not need to match real content. Only the extension, size and the 'text/plain' type are tested.
201	- The delete guard does not look at `custitem`, `stockserialitems`, `worequirements`, `woitems` and the other tables Z_ChangeStockCode updates, so a delete could succeed with rows still pointing at the item. Whether the database refuses depends on its foreign keys (not shown here).
202	- A repeated insert of the same code is refused by the duplicate check, so the item is not created twice.
203	
204	## Hazards
205	- Category rename: the old category row is deleted outside the transaction.
206	- Item-code rename: if the transaction commit succeeds and the old-row DELETE fails, both items exist. If an image rename fails, the image is lost from the new code.
207	- No explicit rollback for any failed transaction step.
208	- No permission checks on any of the three scripts.
209	- GL journal accounts and balance are unchecked.
210	- `GetNextTransNo` only serialises concurrent callers when the call is inside a transaction.
211	- `ChangeFieldInTable` failures are unhandled, so a partial rename is possible.
212	- The `needsrevision='0'` update runs for all translations of the item when the description changed, even if translation text was just rewritten.
213	
214	## Open first
215	- `webERP/Stocks.php`: all item logic (navigation, upload, validation, update, insert, delete, form).
216	- `webERP/Z_ChangeStockCode.php`: item-code rename.
217	- `webERP/Z_ChangeStockCategory.php`: category rename.
218	- `webERP/includes/SQL_CommonFunctions.php`: `GetNextTransNo`.

# webERP stock item maintenance: Stocks.php plus the Z_ChangeStockCategory.php and Z_ChangeStockCode.php utilities

Part of [webERP sales, purchasing, stock, work-order, GL and master-data pages](weberp-sales-purchasing-stock-work-order-gl-and-master-data--151/brief.md) (path from the export's root): its brief says how work moves through the area and what repairs a failed step.

Stocks.php is the item create, update and delete page, with navigation, multilingual descriptions, category properties and image upload. The two Z_ utilities rename a stock category code or an item code across the related tables. All of it reads and writes `stockmaster` and the tables around it directly, and it takes transaction numbers from `GetNextTransNo`.

## Contract
- **In:**
  - POST/GET form fields: `StockID` (trimmed, uppercased), `NextItem`, `PreviousItem`, `UpdateCategories`, `New`, `submit`, `delete`, `ClearImage`, `ItemPicture` (file).
  - Item fields: `Description`, `LongDescription`, `Units`, `BarCode`, `Volume`, `GrossWeight`, `NetWeight`, `EOQ`, `Controlled`, `Serialised`, `Perishable`, `NextSerialNo`, `MBFlag`, `CategoryID`, `Pansize`, `ShrinkFactor`, `Discontinued`, `DiscountCategory`, `TaxCat`, `DecimalPlaces`.
  - Language fields: `Description_<LanguageId>`, `LongDescription_<LanguageId>`.
  - Property fields: `PropertyCounter`, `PropID<i>`, `PropNumeric<i>`, `PropType<i>`, `PropValue<i>`, `PropMin<i>`, `PropMax<i>`.
  - Z_ChangeStockCategory.php: `ProcessStockChange`, `OldStockCategory`, `NewStockCategory`.
  - Z_ChangeStockCode.php: `OldStockID`, `NewStockID` (uppercased).
  - Session values: `ItemDescriptionLanguages` (comma-separated), `MaxImageSize` (KB), `part_pics_dir`, `CompanyRecord['gllink_stock']`, `DefaultDateFormat`, `DefaultTaxCategory`, `SelectedStockItem`.
- **Out, written tables:**
  - `stockmaster`
  - `stockdescriptiontranslations`
  - `stockitemproperties`
  - `locstock`
  - `gltrans` (type 0 journals)
  - `stockcategory`
  - `stockcatproperties`
  - `salesanalysis`
  - `internalstockcatrole`
  - about 35 item-keyed tables for the item-code rename (listed under Z_ChangeStockCode.php below)
- **Out, files:** item images at `part_pics_dir/<StockID>.<png|jpg|jpeg>`.
- **Out, delete:** rows deleted from `locstock`, `prices`, `purchdata`, `bom` (parent), `stockitemproperties`, `stockdescriptiontranslations` and `stockmaster`.

## Entry points

### Stocks.php, request start
No permission check and no FormID check are shown.
1. `if GET/POST StockID set -> trim, uppercase to $StockID`, else `$StockID = ''`.
2. `if NextItem -> SELECT stockmaster WHERE stockid > $StockID ORDER ASC LIMIT 1`. A hit sets `$StockID` to it; no hit sets `$HasNext = false`. The `Description_*` POST values are unset.
3. `if PreviousItem -> stockid < $StockID ORDER DESC LIMIT 1`. A hit sets `$StockID` to it; no hit sets `$HasPrev = false`. The `Description_*` POST values are unset.
4. `if $StockID != '' and UpdateCategories not set -> count stockmaster WHERE stockid=$StockID`. A count of 0 sets `$New = 1`, otherwise `$New = 0`.
5. `if POST New set -> $New = $_POST['New']`.

### Stocks.php, image upload
Runs when `ItemPicture` name is not empty.
- `$ImgExt` comes from the file name. `$FileName = part_pics_dir/StockID.ImgExt`. `$UploadTheFile = 'Yes'` to start.
- `$UploadTheFile = 'No'` (with a warning) for each of these:
  - `ImgExt not in (png, jpg, jpeg)`
  - `size > MaxImageSize*1024`
  - `type == 'text/plain'`
  - `error == 6`
  - `not is_writable(part_pics_dir)`
- Existing `StockID.png`, `StockID.jpg` and `StockID.jpeg` files are unlinked first. If an unlink fails, an error is shown and `$UploadTheFile = 'No'`.
- `if $UploadTheFile == 'Yes' -> move_uploaded_file`. The result message is a link on success, or 'Something is wrong with uploading' on failure.

### Stocks.php, submit validation
Each failure sets `$InputError = 1`, shows an error and records the field in `$Errors`. All checks run (no early exit).
1. `!isset(Description) or len > 50 or len == 0` -> Description.
2. `len(LongDescription) == 0` -> LongDescription.
3. `len(StockID) == 0` -> StockID.
4. `ContainsIllegalCharacters(StockID) or strpos(StockID,' ')` -> StockID, and `$StockID = ''`.
5. `len(Units) > 20` -> Units.
6. `len(BarCode) > 20` -> BarCode.
7. Volume, GrossWeight, NetWeight and EOQ: `!is_numeric(filter_number_format(x))` or `< 0` -> that field.
8. `Controlled == 0 and Serialised == 1` -> Serialised.
9. `NextSerialNo != 0 and Serialised == 0` -> NextSerialNo.
10. `NextSerialNo != 0 and MBFlag != 'M'` -> NextSerialNo.
11. `MBFlag in (A, K, D, G) and Controlled == 1` -> Controlled.
12. `trim(CategoryID) == ''` -> CategoryID.
13. Pansize and ShrinkFactor: `!is_numeric(filter_number_format(x))` -> that field.
- `if Serialised == 1 -> DecimalPlaces = 0`.

### Stocks.php, extra checks when `$New == 0`
The check on `$New` is partly off-screen. The checks below are shown. Each sets `InputError=1`.
- `OldMBFlag != MBFlag and OldMBFlag in [M,B] and MBFlag in [A,K,D,G]` combined with:
  - `StockQtyRow[0] != 0 and OldMBFlag != G` -> refused, stock on hand.
  - `Controlled == 1` -> refused, lot controlled.
- `MBFlag == K` and open sales order lines (`stkcode=StockID AND completed=0` and `quantity-qtyinvoiced != 0`) -> refused.
- `MBFlag in [K,A,D]` and open purchase order lines -> refused. The lines are those with `purchorderdetails.completed=0`, `purchorders.status not in [Cancelled, Completed, Rejected]` and `quantityord-quantityrecd != 0`.
- `OldMBFlag in [M,K,A,G] and MBFlag in [B,D]` and a BOM with `parent=StockID` -> refused.
- `OldMBFlag in [M,B,D,G] and MBFlag in [A,K]` and a BOM with `component=StockID` -> refused.
- `OldControlled != Controlled and StockQtyRow[0] != 0` -> refused.
- `OldSerialised != Serialised and StockQtyRow[0] != 0` -> refused.
- Property loop `i < PropertyCounter`: `PropNumeric[i]==1 and (value < PropMin[i] or value > PropMax[i])` -> refused.

### Stocks.php, update (`$InputError == 0`, existing item)
1. `DB_Txn_Begin`.
2. UPDATE `stockmaster` (numeric fields go through `filter_number_format`).
3. `if count(languages) > 0` -> per language, DELETE then INSERT in `stockdescriptiontranslations`.
4. `if OldDescription != Description or OldLongDescription != LongDescription -> UPDATE stockdescriptiontranslations SET needsrevision='0' WHERE stockid`. This applies to all of the item's translations.
5. DELETE `stockitemproperties`, then INSERT per property. `PropType==2` becomes 1 if the value is 'on', otherwise 0. `PropNumeric==1` goes through `filter_number_format`.
6. `if OldStockAccount != NewStockAct and gllink_stock == 1` -> `GetNextTransNo(0)` for the journal number. Two `gltrans` type 0 rows follow: debit `NewStockAct` and credit `OldStockAccount`, amount `UnitCost * StockQtyRow[0]`.
7. `if OldWIPAccount != NewWIPAct and gllink_stock == 1` -> sum open work order WIP (`workorders.closed=0`), per row `costissued - costrecd`. `if WIPValue != 0` -> `GetNextTransNo(0)`, then two type 0 rows: debit `NewWIPAct`, credit `OldWIPAccount`.
8. `DB_Txn_Commit`, then success message.

### Stocks.php, insert (new item)
- `if DB_num_rows(SELECT stockid WHERE stockid=...) == 1 -> InputError=1, Errors[]='StockID'`, with a duplicate-code message.
- Otherwise: `DB_Txn_Begin`, INSERT `stockmaster`.
- `if DB_error_no()==0`:
  - INSERT `stockdescriptiontranslations` per language, only if there are languages.
  - INSERT `stockitemproperties` per property.
  - `INSERT INTO locstock SELECT locations.loccode, StockID FROM locations`.
  - `DB_Txn_Commit`.
  - `if DB_error_no()==0` -> unset the POST fields and set `$New=1`.

### Stocks.php, delete
Runs when `POST delete` is set and `mb_strlen > 1`. `$CancelDelete = 1` with a warning (and a count) if any of these holds:
- `stockmoves` count > 0 for the item.
- `bom` with `component=StockID` > 0.
- `salesorderdetails` with `stkcode` > 0.
- `salesanalysis` > 0.
- `purchorderdetails` with `itemcode` > 0.
- `GetQuantityOnHand(StockID,'ALL') != 0`.
- `offers` count != 0.
- `tenderitems` count != 0.

If `$CancelDelete == 0`:
1. `DB_Txn_Begin`.
2. DELETE from `locstock`, `prices`, `purchdata`, `bom` (parent), `stockitemproperties`, `stockdescriptiontranslations` and `stockmaster`, in that order.
3. `DB_Txn_Commit`, then success message.
4. Unset the POST fields, `$_SESSION['SelectedStockItem']` and `$StockID`; `$New = 1`.

### Stocks.php, form display
- `if StockID unset/'' or UpdateCategories set` -> blank or new form.
- `elseif UpdateCategories unset and InputError != 1` -> load `stockmaster` and `stockdescriptiontranslations` into the form.
- `else` -> keep the posted values.
- Defaults:
  - EOQ, Volume, GrossWeight, NetWeight, Controlled, Pansize, ShrinkFactor, NextSerialNo, DecimalPlaces, Discontinued -> 0.
  - `Serialised` -> 0 if empty or `Controlled == 0`.
  - `Units` -> 'each'.
  - `TaxCat` -> `$_SESSION['DefaultTaxCategory']`.
- `MBFlag` select:
  - Pre-selected only on A (Assembly), D (Service/Labour) and when unset.
  - Kit, Manufactured, Phantom and Purchased are each selected when unset or equal to their own flag. Phantom and Purchased also select on ''.
- `NextSerialNo` is shown only if `Serialised == 1 and MBFlag == 'M'`, otherwise a hidden 0.
- `if ClearImage` -> unlink the png, jpg and jpeg files. `if is_file` still true -> error 'You do not have access to delete this item image file'.
- `if New == 1` -> editable StockID and a `submit` 'Insert New Item' button.
- `if New != 1` -> 'Update' and 'Delete This Item' buttons. Delete has a JS confirm.
- Previous/Next buttons show if `StockID != '' and InputError == 0`.
- Property inputs come from `stockcatproperties WHERE categoryid=CategoryID AND reqatsalesorder=0`. `controltype` 0 is a textbox (numeric gets min/max hidden inputs), 1 is a select (defaultvalue split by comma), 2 is a checkbox. Values come from `stockitemproperties` when `StockID` is set.

### Z_ChangeStockCategory.php (`if isset(ProcessStockChange)`)
Each check below ends the run with an error:
- `old category not in stockcategory` (0 rows).
- `ContainsIllegalCharacters(NewStockCategory)`.
- `NewStockCategory == ''`.
- `new category already exists` (rows != 0).

Then:
1. `DB_Txn_Begin`.
2. INSERT a copy of the old `stockcategory` row under the new id.
3. UPDATE `stockcatproperties.categoryid`.
4. UPDATE `stockmaster.categoryid`.
5. UPDATE `salesanalysis.stkcategory`.
6. UPDATE `internalstockcatrole.categoryid`.
7. `SET FOREIGN_KEY_CHECKS=1`.
8. `DB_Txn_Commit`.
9. DELETE the old `stockcategory` row, outside the transaction.

### Z_ChangeStockCode.php
Each check sets `$InputError = 1`:
- `old code not in stockmaster`.
- `ContainsIllegalCharacters(NewStockID)`.
- `NewStockID == ''`.
- `new code already exists`.

If `InputError == 0`:
1. `DB_IgnoreForeignKeys`, `DB_Txn_Begin`.
2. INSERT a new `stockmaster` row.
3. `ChangeFieldInTable` over `locstock`, `stockmoves`, `loctransfers`, `mrpdemands`, `mrpplannedorders` (if it exists), `mrprequirements` (if it exists), `mrpsupplies` (if it exists), `salesanalysis`, `orderdeliverydifferenceslog`, `prices`, `salesorderdetails`, `purchorderdetails`, `purchdata`, `shipmentcharges`, `stockcheckfreeze`, `stockcounts`, `grns`, `contractbom`, `bom` (component and parent), `stockrequestitems`, `stockdescriptiontranslations`, `custitem`, `pricematrix`, `pickreqdetails`, `stockitemproperties`, `worequirements` (stockid and parentstockid), `woitems`, `salescatprod`, `stockserialitems`, `stockserialmoves`, `offers`, `tenderitems`, `prodspecs`, `qasamples`. The condensation says 24 calls but lists more tables.
4. For each of png, jpg and jpeg: rename the image file, or report 'failed' or 'no image to rename'.
5. `DB_ReinstateForeignKeys`, `DB_Txn_Commit`.
6. DELETE the old `stockmaster` row.
7. If `$_SESSION['SelectedStockItem'] == OldStockID`, set it to `NewStockID`.

## Decisions
- `Stocks.php` GL journal on account change: the stock account journal is only posted when `gllink_stock == 1`. The WIP journal is also skipped when the net WIP value is 0.
- `Stocks.php` MBFlag change (rules above): `stock on hand` blocks M/B to A/K/D/G unless the old flag was G.
- `Stocks.php` delete: a `stockmaster` row is only removed when there are no movements, BOM component uses, sales order lines, sales analysis rows, purchase order lines, stock on hand, offers or tenders for the item.
- Because the delete guard has no check on `prices`, `purchdata` or `locstock`, those rows are deleted along with the item.
- Both Z_ scripts refuse when the new code already exists.

## Order and failure
- **Update:** everything is inside one transaction. Errors from `DB_query` are re-raised to the caller. No explicit rollback is shown, and `DB_Txn_Commit` follows the later steps.
- **Insert:** the transaction wraps all inserts. If the `stockmaster` INSERT fails (`DB_error_no != 0`), the remaining inserts are skipped. No explicit rollback is shown.
- **Delete:** the queries are inside a transaction. No check of per-query success before commit is shown.
- **Z_ChangeStockCategory:** the old-category DELETE is outside the transaction, after commit. If it fails, both category rows exist. The message for each step is passed to `DB_query` (with the transaction flag `true`).
- **Z_ChangeStockCode:** the old `stockmaster` row is deleted after commit. A failed `ChangeFieldInTable` or image rename is not handled; the rename is only reported in the output.
- **GetNextTransNo:** it runs `SELECT ... FOR UPDATE`, `UPDATE systypes SET typeno = typeno + 1`, then re-SELECTs `typeno` and returns it. Failures show a 'CRITICAL ERROR' message through `DB_query`. The row lock is held until the surrounding transaction ends, so the number is serialised only inside a transaction. In Stocks.php it is called inside the update transaction, after `DB_Txn_Begin`.
- No loops poll or retry.

## Connections
- **`GetNextTransNo(0)`** (`webERP/includes/SQL_CommonFunctions.php`): called by Stocks.php for the stock and WIP cost journals. Type 0 is the journal type. It reads and increments `systypes.typeno` for `typeid=0` and returns the new value, which Stocks.php uses as `typeno` in `gltrans`.
- **`GetQuantityOnHand($StockID,'ALL')`** (behaviour not in this topic): used by the delete guard.
- **Helper functions** (behaviour not in this topic): `ContainsIllegalCharacters`, `filter_number_format`, `locale_number_format`, `GetImageLink`, `ChangeFieldInTable`, `DB_IgnoreForeignKeys`, `DB_ReinstateForeignKeys`.
- **Shared tables:** `stockmaster`, `stockcategory`, `stockcatproperties`, `locstock`, `locations`, `gltrans`, `systypes`, `workorders`, `woitems`, `salesorderdetails`, `purchorderdetails`, `purchorders`, `bom` and the other tables named above.
- **Session:** `$_SESSION['SelectedStockItem']` is shared with the other stock pages. It is unset on delete and updated on code rename.

## Conclusions
- Stocks.php posts the stock journal using `UnitCost * StockQtyRow[0]`. This only happens if the stock account changed with `gllink_stock == 1`. `gltrans` rows are not checked against the GL accounts and no balance check is made, but the two rows carry the same amount in opposite directions.
- Changing a category's stock accounts does not itself post journals here. Only item-level account changes do. The category-change path appears to set the accounts through `UpdateCategories` and the form. The same item-level journals are posted from `$OldStockAccount != $NewStockAct`.
- Z_ChangeStockCategory moves only `stockcatproperties`, `stockmaster`, `salesanalysis` and `internalstockcatrole`. It leaves other tables that refer to the category alone. Other parts keeping their own copy of the category code will keep the old one.
- Z_ChangeStockCode has no duplicate guard beyond the form check. Submitting the same rename twice fails the second time, since the old code no longer exists.
- Image-name checks in Stocks.php do not need to match real content. Only the extension, size and the 'text/plain' type are tested.
- The delete guard does not look at `custitem`, `stockserialitems`, `worequirements`, `woitems` and the other tables Z_ChangeStockCode updates, so a delete could succeed with rows still pointing at the item. Whether the database refuses depends on its foreign keys (not shown here).
- A repeated insert of the same code is refused by the duplicate check, so the item is not created twice.

## Hazards
- Category rename: the old category row is deleted outside the transaction.
- Item-code rename: if the transaction commit succeeds and the old-row DELETE fails, both items exist. If an image rename fails, the image is lost from the new code.
- No explicit rollback for any failed transaction step.
- No permission checks on any of the three scripts.
- GL journal accounts and balance are unchecked.
- `GetNextTransNo` only serialises concurrent callers when the call is inside a transaction.
- `ChangeFieldInTable` failures are unhandled, so a partial rename is possible.
- The `needsrevision='0'` update runs for all translations of the item when the description changed, even if translation text was just rewritten.

## Open first
- `webERP/Stocks.php`: all item logic (navigation, upload, validation, update, insert, delete, form).
- `webERP/Z_ChangeStockCode.php`: item-code rename.
- `webERP/Z_ChangeStockCategory.php`: category rename.
- `webERP/includes/SQL_CommonFunctions.php`: `GetNextTransNo`.

# webERP Z_Import* utilities and StockCounts: CSV bulk-import pages and the stock-count entry page

Part of [webERP sales, purchasing, stock, work-order, GL and master-data pages](weberp-sales-purchasing-stock-work-order-gl-and-master-data--151/brief.md) (path from the export's root): its brief says how work moves through the area and what repairs a failed step.

This topic holds webERP's one-off CSV import pages (chart of accounts, GL account groups and sections, GL transactions, fixed assets, part codes, price list, stock items, suppliers) and `StockCounts.php`. Each import page takes an uploaded CSV, validates it and writes to the database, either in one transaction or row by row through an API function. They call `GetNextTransNo` and `GetPeriod` (in includes), `InsertGLAccountGroup`, `InsertGLAccountSection`, `InsertStockItem`, and `includes/GLPostings.php`.

## Contract
**In (all pages):** HTTP form posts with an uploaded CSV (comma-separated, header row first), plus a `gettemplate` GET flag on some pages.

| Page | Upload field | Other inputs | Header (case-insensitive match) |
|---|---|---|---|
| `webERP/Z_ImportChartOfAccounts.php` | `ChartFile` | – | Account Code, Description, Account Group (3) |
| `webERP/Z_ImportFixedAssets.php` | `SelectedAssetFile` | `DateToEnter`, `FromUserID`, `ToUserID` | Description, LongDescription, AssetCategoryID, SerialNo, BarCode, AssetLocationCode, Cost, AccumDepn, DepnType, DepnRate, DatePurchased (11) |
| `webERP/Z_ImportGLAccountGroups.php` | `ImportFile` | `update` | Column names are free; the page uses them as array keys |
| `webERP/Z_ImportGLAccountSections.php` | `ImportFile` | `update` | Column names are free; the page uses them as array keys |
| `webERP/Z_ImportGLTransactions.php` | `userfile` | `TransactionType`, `Currency` | Date, Account, ChequeNo, Amount, Narrative, Tag (6) |
| `webERP/Z_ImportPartCodes.php` | `ImportFile` | `update` | Column names are free; the page uses them as array keys |
| `webERP/Z_ImportPriceList.php` | `PriceListFile` | `StartDate` | StockID, SalesType, CurrencyCode, Price (4) |
| `webERP/Z_ImportStocks.php` | `userfile` | – | StockID, Description, LongDescription, CategoryID, Units, MBFlag, EOQ, Discontinued, Controlled, Serialised, Perishable, Volume, grossweight, BarCode, DiscountCategory, TaxCat, DecimalPlaces, ItemPDF (18) |
| `webERP/Z_ImportSuppliers.php` | `userfile` | `UpdateIfExists` (0/1) | SupplierID, SuppName, Address1-6, Phone, Fax, Email, SupplierType, CurrCode, SupplierSince, PaymentTerms, BankPartics, BankRef, BankAct, Remittance, TaxGroup, FactorID, latitude, longitude, TaxRef |

**Out:** DB writes and `prnMsg` or HTML output.

| Page | Tables written | How |
|---|---|---|
| Chart of accounts | `chartmaster` (accountcode, accountname, group_) | One transaction, then `includes/GLPostings.php` |
| Fixed assets | `fixedassets`, `fixedassettrans` | `fixedassettrans` gets two rows per asset, types `cost` and `depn` |
| GL transactions | `gltrans`, `banktrans` | One transaction |
| Price list | `prices` | UPDATE closes open prices, then INSERT |
| Stocks | `stockmaster`, `locstock` | `locstock` is INSERT…SELECT from `locations` |
| Suppliers | `suppliers` | INSERT or UPDATE |
| GL account groups, GL account sections, part codes | – | Through `InsertGLAccountGroup($AccountGroupDetails,'','')`, `InsertGLAccountSection($AccountSectionDetails,'','')` and `InsertStockItem($ItemDetails,'','')`. A return of `$Answer[0]==0` means success (behaviour not in this topic) |

`webERP/StockCounts.php`: GET/POST `Action` ('View' or 'Enter'), GET `gettemplate`, and `$_SESSION['FormID']` in the form. The template CSV header is StockCode, QtyCounted, Reference.

## Entry points and guards (in order)
No page shows a permission check.

**Chart of accounts**
- `if isset($_FILES['ChartFile']) and name` -> process the file; otherwise show the form.
- `if count($HeadRow) != 3` -> error, fclose, exit.
- `if header name mismatch` -> error, exit.
- `if count($MyRow) != 3` -> error, exit.
- `if COUNT(groupname) in accountgroups == 0` -> `$InputError=1`.
- `if $InputError != 1` -> INSERT into chartmaster.
- `if $InputError==1` -> break.

**Fixed assets**
- `if isset($_FILES['SelectedAssetFile']['name'])` -> process the file.
- `elseif gettemplate` -> output the CSV header.
- Otherwise show the upload form with a date selector.
- `if count($HeaderRow) != count($FieldNames)` -> error, exit.
- `if header name mismatch` -> error, exit.
- `if row field count != 11` -> error, exit.
- Per-row checks that set `$InputError=true`; none of them stops the loop, so all errors are collected:
  - `strlen(Description)==0 or >50`
  - `!is_numeric(DepnRate)`
  - `DepnRate<0 or >100`
  - `!is_numeric(AccumDepn)`
  - `AccumDepn<0`
  - `!is_numeric(Cost)`
  - `Cost<=0`
  - `DepnType !='SL' AND !='DV'`
  - `fixedassetcategories` has no row for the category
  - `fixedassetlocations` has no row for the location
  - `!Is_Date(DatePurchased)`
- `DepnType` 'DV' becomes 1, otherwise 0.
- `if FromUserID==ToUserID` -> error, `$InputError=1`.
- `if $InputError == false` -> `GetNextTransNo(49)`, `GetPeriod(ConvertSQLDate(DateToEnter))`, INSERT `fixedassets`.
  - If `DB_error_no()==0`: `DB_Last_Insert_ID('fixedassets','assetid')`, then two `fixedassettrans` INSERTs (`cost` and `depn`), then a success message.

**GL account groups and sections**
- `if isset($_POST['update'])` -> process; otherwise show the form (the sections page also shows an info message).
- `if $FieldValues[0]!=''` -> build the array and call the Insert function.
- Groups page: `if $Answer[0]==0` -> success and `$successes++`; otherwise failure, list errors, `$failures++`.
- Sections page: same, with `$ErrorDescription` giving the error text.

**GL transactions**
- `if isset($_FILES['userfile']) and name` -> process.
- If the first cell starts with the BOM `\xef\xbb\xbf`, strip it.
- `if count($HeadRow) != 6` -> error, exit.
- `if header name mismatch` -> error, exit.
- `GetNextTransNo($_POST['TransactionType'])`.
- SELECT the currency rate for `$_POST['Currency']`.
- `DB_Txn_Begin()`.
- Per row:
  - `if field count != target` -> error, exit.
  - `if COUNT(accountcode) in chartmaster == 0` -> `$InputError=1`.
  - `if !Is_date(row[0])` -> `$InputError=1`.
  - `GetPeriod(row[0])`.
  - `if isset($PreviousPeriod) and $PreviousPeriod != $Period` -> `$InputError=1`.
  - Amount is cast to float.
  - `if $InputError != 1` -> INSERT `gltrans`.
  - `if TransactionType != 0 AND IsBankAccount(row[1])` -> read the rate from currencies joined to bankaccounts, INSERT `banktrans` (banktranstype `__('Cheque')`).
  - Add the amount to `$TransactionTotal`.
  - `if $InputError==1` -> break.
- After the loop: `if $InputError != 1 and round($TransactionTotal,2) != 0` -> `$InputError=1`.
- Then rollback if `$InputError==1`, otherwise commit.

**Part codes**
- `if isset($_POST['update'])` -> process; otherwise show the form.
- `if DB_num_rows(select * from locations)==0` -> error "No locations have been set up...".
- Per row: `if $FieldValues[0] != ''` -> map to `$ItemDetails`, call `InsertStockItem`.
  - `$Answer[0]==0` -> success row.
  - Otherwise failure row listing the errors.
- No transaction wraps the loop.

**Price list**
- `if $_FILES['PriceListFile']['name']` is set and non-empty -> process.
- BOM, header count != 4, and header name mismatch each give an error and exit.
- Data row field count != 4 -> error, exit.
- Per row: StockID not in `stockmaster`, SalesType not in `salestypes` (typeabbrev), or CurrencyCode not in `currencies` (currabrev) -> `InputError=1`.
- `if InputError==1` -> break and rollback.
- Otherwise commit.

**Stocks**
- `if isset($_FILES['userfile']['name'])` -> process.
- `elseif gettemplate` -> template download.
- Otherwise show the form.
- Header count != 18 or name mismatch -> error, exit.
- Row field count != 18 -> error, exit.
- Per-row checks, each setting `$InputError=1`:
  - StockID already in `stockmaster`.
  - Description empty or >50.
  - LongDescription empty.
  - StockID empty.
  - `ContainsIllegalCharacters(StockID)` or contains a space (StockID is then blanked).
  - Units >20 chars.
  - Barcode >20 chars.
  - `Perishable != 0 and != 1`.
  - Volume not numeric, or <0.
  - Weight not numeric, or <0.
  - EOQ not numeric, or <0.
  - `Controlled==0 AND Serialised==1`.
  - MBFlag not one of M, K, A, B, D, G.
  - MBFlag in A, K, D, G with `Controlled==1`.
  - CategoryID empty.
  - ItemPDF empty.
- `if $InputError != 1 AND Serialised==1` -> DecimalPlaces set to 0.
- `DB_Txn_Begin()`, INSERT `stockmaster`.
- `if DB_error_no()==0` -> INSERT `locstock`; otherwise `$InputError=1`, print the error, break.
- Rollback if `$InputError==1`, otherwise commit.

**Suppliers**
- `if isset($_FILES['userfile']) and name` -> process.
- `elseif gettemplate` -> CSV header only.
- Header count mismatch and header name mismatch give an error and exit.
- Row field count != `$FieldTarget` -> error, exit.
- Per-row checks, each setting `$InputError=1`:
  - SuppName length 0 or >40.
  - SupplierID empty.
  - `ContainsIllegalCharacters(SupplierID)`.
  - Phone >25.
  - Fax >25.
  - Email >55.
  - Email non-empty and `!IsEmailAddress`.
  - BankRef >12.
  - `!Is_Date(SupplierSince)`.
- `if $InputError != 1` -> `SELECT COUNT(supplierid)`; `>0` sets `$SuppExists`.
- `SuppExists AND UpdateIfExists != 1` -> `$UpdatedNum++`, no update.
- `SuppExists AND UpdateIfExists == 1` -> `$UpdatedNum++`, UPDATE suppliers.
  - `currcode` is only updated if `supptrans` has no rows for the supplier (`$SuppTrans==0`).
  - If the old currency differs from `$_POST['CurrCode']`, an info message says it cannot change currency.
- `!SuppExists` -> `$InsertNum++`, INSERT.
- `InputError==1` -> break and rollback; otherwise commit with the counts.

**StockCounts.php**
- If neither POST nor GET `Action` is set -> 'Enter'.
- If POST `Action` is set -> it overwrites GET.
- If GET `Action` is not 'View' or 'Enter' -> 'Enter'.
- If `gettemplate` is set, the page sends these headers:
  - Content-Type: application/force-download, application/octet-stream, application/download
  - Content-Disposition: attachment; filename=ImportTemplate.csv
  - Content-Transfer-Encoding: binary
- It then calls `ob_clean()`, outputs the header row, includes the footer and exits.
- Otherwise it calls `ob_end_flush()`.
- The source ends at an incomplete `if ($_GET['Action']=='Enter')`, so no Enter or View logic is shown.

## Decisions
- Every transactional importer uses `$InputError==1` to choose rollback over commit. These are chart of accounts, fixed assets, GL transactions, price list, stocks and suppliers.
- Failure messages: "Failed on row N. Batch import … rolled back" (chart of accounts, fixed assets, suppliers, GL transactions).
- Part codes, GL groups and GL sections process each row independently. A failed row does not stop later rows, and there is no rollback.
- The Insert APIs apply their own validation (behaviour not in this topic).
- `Z_ImportSuppliers.php` with `UpdateIfExists != 1` counts existing suppliers as "Exist" and does not write them.
- `Z_ImportSuppliers.php` validates `$_POST['SuppName']`, `Phone` and similar, not the CSV row values (the condensation lists `$_POST` names; how row values map to them is not shown).

## Order and failure
- A header or field-count error does `fclose` and `exit`.
  - Chart of accounts, GL transactions and stocks: this happens inside an open transaction or before commit. The condensations show no rollback call on that path (GL transactions notes the transaction is left open).
  - Fixed assets, price list and suppliers: whether the exit comes before or after `DB_Txn_Begin()` is not shown.
- GL transactions calls `GetNextTransNo` before `DB_Txn_Begin()`. Inside it:
  - SELECT … FOR UPDATE on `systypes`
  - UPDATE `typeno=typeno+1`
  - SELECT of the new `typeno`
- That increment is not in the import's transaction, so a rolled-back import still consumes a number.
- Fixed assets calls `GetNextTransNo(49)` and `GetPeriod` per valid asset (inside the transaction).
- `GetNextTransNo` errors are CRITICAL ERROR messages through `DB_query`'s `$ErrMsg`.
- `GetPeriod($TransDate,$UseProhibit=true)`:
  - It parses the date by separator `/`, `-` or `.`, and by `$_SESSION['DefaultDateFormat']`.
  - If `ProhibitPostingsBefore` is a valid date, earlier dates are moved up to it.
  - If `periods` is empty, it inserts periods 0 and 1.
  - If the date has no period (`!PeriodExists`), it creates missing periods with `CreatePeriod` after the last period or before the first, and then returns the period number.
  - So importing dates far out creates `periods` rows.
- The `GetPeriod` body past line 1338 was not read.
- In the GL transactions import, `gltrans` rows are skipped once `$InputError` is set, but the rollback undoes earlier inserts.
- The chart of accounts import ends with `fclose` and `include('includes/GLPostings.php')` (behaviour not in this topic). That include is reported as "bug: file not found" in a comment.
- No page handles `fopen` or `fgetcsv` failure.

## Connections
- `webERP/includes/SQL_CommonFunctions.php` `GetNextTransNo($TransType)`: returns the incremented `systypes.typeno`. Called by the GL transactions import (type from `$_POST['TransactionType']`) and the fixed assets import (type 49).
- `webERP/includes/DateFunctions.php` `GetPeriod`: returns the period number. Called by the GL transactions import and the fixed assets import.
- Tables read: `accountgroups`, `fixedassetcategories`, `fixedassetlocations`, `chartmaster`, `currencies`, `bankaccounts`, `stockmaster`, `salestypes`, `locations`, `supptrans`, `suppliers`.
- Tables written: see the Contract table.
- `$_SESSION['FormID']` is embedded in forms.
- `$_SESSION['DefaultDateFormat']` and `ProhibitPostingsBefore` are read by `GetPeriod` and the date checks.
- The part-code, group and section pages hand rows to the Insert API functions.

## Conclusions
- No page checks a permission, so any user who can reach it can bulk-write accounts, assets, prices, stock and suppliers.
- `MAX_FILE_SIZE=1000000` is only a hidden form field, and no PHP code checks it.
- Price list: there is no duplicate check, and `UPDATE prices` closes open prices for the matching stockid and typeabbrev, so the old rows get `enddate=StartDate`. A row whose stock id exists but whose price is empty is inserted with price 0.
- Importing the same chart of accounts file twice: the second INSERT depends on the schema's key and may fail, which rolls the batch back; no pre-check exists. Stocks reject existing StockIDs, so a second run fails with "already exists". Suppliers re-run is idempotent when `UpdateIfExists` is 0 and refreshes the data when it is 1. Part codes, groups and sections depend on the Insert functions.
- GL transactions: all rows must fall in one period (`PreviousPeriod != Period` -> error) and must sum to zero after rounding to 2 decimals. Note that `GetPeriod` may move prohibited-period dates forward, so dates before `ProhibitPostingsBefore` are accepted and mapped to the same period. For TransactionType 0, no `banktrans` rows are written. For non-zero types, only rows whose account is a bank account write `banktrans`.
- Fixed assets: `DepnType` is stored as 1 for DV and 0 for SL. One asset gets two `fixedassettrans` rows. The "FromUserID == ToUserID" check does not relate to any CSV field and rejects the batch, so it depends on form fields not described. A bad row does not stop validation, so the rollback message appears only after the whole file has been checked.
- Fixed asset error text says "more than 3 characters" while the code checks only `strlen==0` or `>50`.
- Stocks: the `locstock` rows are created for every location. `ItemPDF` has to hold a filename or `none`. Stocks does not check that `CategoryID`, `TaxCat` or `MBFlag` references exist beyond the checks listed.
- Suppliers does not check that `CurrCode`, `SupplierType`, `PaymentTerms`, `TaxGroup` or `FactorID` exist.
- Suppliers does not check latitude or longitude.
- `StockCounts.php` has no live Enter or View body in the source shown, so nothing about saving counts follows from it. Its import template is only a download; no importer reading `StockCode, QtyCounted, Reference` is in this topic.
- No sender of these forms was found other than the pages' own forms. The part-code and GL pages hand rows to the Insert API functions, whose acceptance of the array keys (taken from the CSV headers) is not checked here.

## Hazards
- Rows are inserted with unescaped CSV values in SQL (no injection protection shown).
- Part codes, groups and sections are partially applied after failures, because there is no rollback.
- Error exits for column errors during open transactions can leave them open (GL transactions explicitly).
- A rolled-back GL import or fixed asset import still increments `systypes.typeno`.
- `GetPeriod` creates `periods` rows as a side effect for far-off dates.
- The price list import can create several active prices for one stock, sales type and currency.
- The supplier page's `UpdateIfExists` update path can silently leave `currcode` unchanged.

## Open first
- `webERP/Z_ImportGLTransactions.php`: the most complex flow (period, balance, bank transactions).
- `webERP/Z_ImportStocks.php`: the longest validation list.
- `webERP/Z_ImportSuppliers.php`: insert/update logic.
- `webERP/Z_ImportFixedAssets.php`: validation and asset records.
- `webERP/Z_ImportPriceList.php`, `webERP/Z_ImportChartOfAccounts.php`: transactional imports.
- `webERP/StockCounts.php`: template download.

  - this topic took from `webERP/includes/SQL_CommonFunctions.php`: `GetNextTransNo` does SELECT typeno FROM systypes FOR UPDATE, UPDATE typeno=typeno+1, SELECT typeno, returns it, with CRITICAL ERROR messages.
- [Inventory and stock reports (webERP): planning, valuation, quantities…](weberp-reporting-and-document-output-153/inventory-and-stock-reports-weberp-planning-valuation-quanti-115/brief.md)

1	# webERP sales, purchasing, stock, work-order, GL and master-data pages
2	
3	Part of the map whose overview is root.md.
4	
5	This area is the set of webERP PHP pages that run order-to-cash, procure-to-pay, stock movement, manufacturing and general-ledger maintenance, plus supporting reference data and the admin utilities that change it. Pages write MySQL directly through `DB_query` and take document numbers from `GetNextTransNo`. They hand output to Dompdf, SMTP, FTP and Nominatim, and the includes under `webERP/includes` are outside the area.
6	
7	## Flows
8	
9	**1. Sales order to invoice**
10	1. *Sales order and item-selection pages* (`SelectOrderItems.php`) build the session cart. It rejects duplicate items, obsolete items and, in credit mode 2, lines over the credit limit.
11	2. `DeliveryDetails.php` validates the delivery details and saves the order or quotation with number 30. A new-order save is transactional, and any auto work-order creation and the factory email run inside it.
12	3. `ConfirmDispatch_Invoice.php` runs its pre-checks, then writes the type 10 invoice in one transaction.
13	   - Pre-checks: negative stock, and whether the order changed since loading.
14	   - The transaction covers stock moves, analysis, commission and GL.
15	   - `EnsureGLEntriesBalance` runs after the commit.
16	   - The page skips lines with zero `QtyDispatched` without any message.
17	   - It silently keeps the old value for an invalid or oversize dispatch quantity.
18	   - `ConfirmDispatchControlled_Invoice.php` only writes serial totals into the session cart.
19	4. `PrintCustTrans.php` renders the document, and `EmailCustTrans.php` redirects to it with the address. The send result is not checked, and the temp PDF is deleted regardless.
20	5. **Failure.** No page here rolls back explicitly. The `DB_query` trap, which sits outside the area, halts the page.
21	
22	**2. Counter sales and returns**
23	
24	`CounterSales.php` posts order, type 10 invoice and type 12 receipt in one transaction. `CounterReturns.php` posts a type 11 credit note and a type 12 refund. The refund must equal the total including tax. Lot-controlled and phantom items are refused at quick entry only.
25	
26	**3. Credit notes**
27	1. `SelectCreditItems.php` builds a manual credit note, and `Credit_Invoice.php` loads one from an invoice. `CreditItemsControlled.php` supplies serials.
28	2. Posting writes type 11 in one transaction. Lines with quantity 0 or less are dropped silently. This includes controlled lines with no serials entered.
29	3. `Z_DeleteCreditNote.php` and `Z_DeleteInvoice.php` reverse posted documents. No part checks authority or existence, and the user must repost the GL.
30	
31	**4. Recurring orders**
32	
33	`RecurringSalesOrders.php` saves a template. `RecurringSalesOrdersProcess.php` creates one order per due template per run, with optional auto-invoice, and emails after commit. It only sees templates at locations the run's session user may update. `Z_SalesIntegrityCheck.php` reports orphans read-only.
34	
35	- **Separate transactions.** The new order and the `lastrecurrence` advance commit in one transaction, and that transaction closes before the auto-invoice transaction opens (`RecurringSalesOrdersProcess.php:97-205`, `:209-250`).
36	  - If the invoice part fails, the template has already moved on and a later run will not retry the order. The result is an open sales order that was never invoiced, and nothing repairs it.
37	  - The order-creation calls pass `true` as the third `DB_query` argument, while the invoice calls pass `('', true)`. The order inserts may therefore not be flagged as inside a transaction (`RecurringSalesOrdersProcess.php:152`). The `DB_query` signature is in the includes.
38	- **Dummy-item rule is a form convention only.** Only dummy-item templates are meant to auto-invoice. The template form is the only place that enforces this: `AllDummyLineItems` hides the selector (`RecurringSalesOrders.php:494-511`).
39	  - The processor trusts `autoinvoice=1`. It posts `standardcost` 0, no `locstock` change and no COGS (`RecurringSalesOrdersProcess.php:209-212`, `:336-369`, `:518`).
40	  - A template that later gains a stocked item, or one whose flag is set directly or by import, invoices real stock without moving or costing it.
41	- **Tax totals reset per line.** The auto-invoice resets `$TaxTotals` inside the line loop (`RecurringSalesOrdersProcess.php:259-320`, `:552-609`).
42	  - The tax GL posting covers only the last line's taxes. `ovgst` and the debtors GL debit carry the tax of every line.
43	  - An auto-invoice with two or more taxed lines therefore posts an unbalanced type 10 GL entry and understates the tax liability.
44	  - The page never calls `EnsureGLEntriesBalance`, so nothing flags the imbalance.
45	  - Every sibling initialises `$TaxTotals` once, before its loop: `ConfirmDispatch_Invoice.php:352`, `CounterSales.php:758`, `CounterReturns.php:678`, `Credit_Invoice.php:319` and `SelectCreditItems.php:690`.
46	- **One tax row only.** The auto-invoice writes exactly one `debtortranstaxes` row (`RecurringSalesOrdersProcess.php:554-584`, `:683-693`).
47	  - The row uses the leftover `$TaxAuthID` and `$Tax`, which belong to the last authority of the last line, even when the tax group has several authorities.
48	  - Tax reports that read `debtortranstaxes` miss every other authority, and the row falls short of `debtortrans.ovgst`.
49	  - With `gllink_debtors` 0, `$Tax` is never set, so the amount comes from an undefined variable.
50	  - `Z_SalesIntegrityCheck.php` checks only that a tax row exists, not its amount, so it passes these invoices.
51	- **Date and period disagree.** Auto-invoices are dated `$DelDate` (`lastrecurrence` plus the interval) but posted to today's period. As a result, `trandate` and `prd`/`periodno` can disagree on `stockmoves`, `gltrans`, `salesanalysis` and `debtortrans` (`RecurringSalesOrdersProcess.php:77-78`, `:103`, `:247`).
52	  - Catching up an overdue template creates one order per run. Each order is backdated by one interval, and all of them land in the current period, so period reports and date-range reports disagree.
53	  - `ConfirmDispatch_Invoice.php` and `Credit_Invoice.php` take the period from the document date (`GetPeriod($DefaultDispatchDate)`, `ConfirmDispatch_Invoice.php:774`).
54	- **Salesperson and commission differ from dispatch.** The auto-invoice credits sales analysis to the branch's salesman (`custbranch.salesman`), not to the order's salesperson. It writes no `salescommissions` row, no cost and no COGS (`RecurringSalesOrdersProcess.php:396-485`).
55	  - `ConfirmDispatch_Invoice.php` keys `salesanalysis` on the order's `SalesPerson` and posts commission (`ConfirmDispatch_Invoice.php:1199-1262`, `:1326-1354`).
56	  - The same customer's revenue therefore lands under a different salesperson depending on the invoicing path, and recurring revenue earns no commission. Copying either page carries one rule or the other.
57	
58	**5. EDI and external export**
59	1. `EDIProcessOrders.php` parses files and inserts orders. Its assignment bug (`CreateOrder = true`) means orders are created even when flags say not to.
60	2. `EDISendInvoices.php` writes and sends invoices but never sets `edisent`. Each run resends everything unsent. The Reece variant marks sent before sending.
61	3. `FTP_RadioBeacon.php` exports an order and sets `printedpackingslip` only after a successful upload.
62	4. `Z_ExportSalesAnalysis.php` uploads CSVs by FTP with hardcoded credentials and no login.
63	
64	**6. Procure to pay**
65	1. A PO comes from `PO_Header.php` and `PO_Items.php`, from `PurchaseByPrefSupplier.php`, from `SelectSalesOrder.php` ("Place PO") or from `OffersReceived.php`.
66	   - The first two are Pending unless the user's `purchorderauth` level strictly exceeds the order value.
67	   - `PO_AuthoriseMyOrders.php` authorises inclusively and does not re-check the user's level.
68	   - `OffersReceived.php` turns accepted tender offers into Pending POs and deletes the offers before mail is confirmed.
69	2. `PO_PDFPurchOrder.php` prints and sets Printed. `GoodsReceived.php` accepts only Printed POs and posts type 25.
70	3. `SupplierInvoice.php` auto-receives only Authorised POs and refuses any PO with a controlled line.
71	4. The invoice and credit screens (`SuppInvGRNs.php`, `SuppCreditGRNs.php`, `SuppTransGLAnalysis.php`, `SuppShiptChgs.php`, `SuppContractChgs.php`, `SuppFixedAssetChgs.php`) only fill the session `SuppTrans`. `SupplierInvoice.php` posts it in one transaction (type 20). It refuses the post if a supplier reference is duplicated.
72	5. `ReverseGRN.php` reverses the unreceived quantity, and invoiced quantity blocks it.
73	   - It posts the reversal in the period of the original delivery date, not today's period. Reversing an old GRN therefore posts back into a past period that may be closed.
74	   - It always sets the PO back to Printed (`ReverseGRN.php:119-140`).
75	
76	**7. Work orders and contracts**
77	1. `WorkOrderEntry.php` creates and saves orders. `WOSerialNos.php` manages serials and `WorkOrderIssue.php` issues components (type 28). `WorkOrderReceive.php` receives output (type 26) and `WorkOrderCosting.php` closes the order and posts variances (type 29).
78	2. `Contracts.php`, `ContractBOM.php` and `ContractOtherReqts.php` make a quotation. Status 2 locks the lines. Close-out posts type 32.
79	
80	**8. Stock movement**
81	- `StockAdjustments.php` and `StockTransfers.php` post immediately. Both are transactional.
82	- `StockLocTransfer.php` creates `loctransfers` shipment rows only. `StockLocTransferReceive.php` posts type 16 in one transaction, which opens before the line loop and commits after it (`StockLocTransferReceive.php:70-80`, `:446`). Its gaps are that zero-quantity lines still post movements and that nothing rolls back explicitly.
83	- Internal requests run in three steps:
84	  1. `InternalStockRequest.php` creates the request.
85	  2. `InternalStockRequestAuthorisation.php` sets it authorised.
86	  3. `InternalStockRequestFulfill.php` issues stock. It commits per line and shows only authorised, open requests.
87	- `StockCounts.php` accepts counts only for items in `stockcheckfreeze`. It warns and skips the rest.
88	
89	## Hazards from interaction
90	- No part adds a rollback. Multi-statement writes without a transaction leave partial data on failure. Examples are PO creation from offers, contract commit and work-order save.
91	- Commits precede side effects such as `EnsureGLEntriesBalance`, email and file deletes. No part repairs a failed one. `RecurringSalesOrdersProcess.php` commits the order and the template advance before its auto-invoice transaction opens, and it never calls `EnsureGLEntriesBalance` (`RecurringSalesOrdersProcess.php:97-250`).
92	- Status vocabularies differ across paths. Manual receipt needs Printed, auto-receipt needs Authorised, and `PO_Header.php` and the authorisation page use different authority tests. `ReverseGRN.php` always resets the PO to Printed. An Authorised PO that came from `SupplierInvoice.php` auto-receipt therefore moves onto the manual-receipt path after a reversal (`ReverseGRN.php:119-140`).
93	- Permission checks sit in SQL joins on `locationusers` at load time. Posting handlers mostly do not re-check them, and many delete and rename pages have no check at all.
94	- Duplicate-post guards are largely absent. Repeating order, invoice, return, adjustment or fulfilment posts can create second documents, and only EDI inbound orders have no guard.
95	- `salesanalysis` has no unique key, and rebuild and cost utilities rewrite history.
96	- SQL is built from unescaped input throughout.
97
